added.member: @origingame/engine/ui/components: Checkbox, Switch, Slider, Select, Tabs, Dialog, Tooltip
added.summary: Added seven reusable core TSX UI controls under `packages/engine/src/ui/controls/` (exported from `@origingame/engine/ui/components` and individually under `@origingame/engine/ui/controls/*`) with pack slots, ARIA roles, keyboard/pointer interaction, and fixtures.

added.member: @origingame/engine/ui Input (IME, clipboard, password, multiline, maxLength, readOnly)
added.summary: Extended `<Input>` with `type`, `inputMode`, `autoComplete`, `secret`, `multiline`, `maxLength`, and `readOnly`, IME preedit composition (`input.composition` rendered underlined until commit), `Ctrl/Cmd+C`/`X` clipboard copy/cut, and `Ctrl/Alt+Arrow` word movement. Added missing ARIA roles (`tree`, `treeitem`, `table`, `columnheader`, `rowheader`, `searchbox`, `scrollbar`, `article`, `banner`, `form`, `complementary`, `contentinfo`, `search`) in `og-ui-next`.

fixed.summary: Reconnected focused `<Input>` `text` (`TextTarget` in CSS px) and `copy` values in the frame response (`tick.rs`) so the web shell's hidden `<input>`/`<textarea>` activates for mobile keyboards, CJK IME composition, autofill, and clipboard copy/cut/paste.
